amd-game-stream.app_readme:
AMD Game Stream

Headless game streaming on an AMD GPU: Xorg + amdgpu + DRI3, Sunshine (VA-API), Steam, RetroArch, Lutris, Heroic and noVNC.

Image source: https://github.com/csaki89/amd-game-stream

The container uses the host network (needed for Sunshine/Moonlight discovery). /dev/dri is passed through the Devices section, never as a bind mount.
amd-game-stream.description: Headless game streaming on an AMD GPU (Xorg + amdgpu + DRI3, Sunshine, Steam, RetroArch, Lutris, Heroic, noVNC). Connect with Moonlight.
